name: TC-694: the client's dealPrice is ignored for computed types, and a client itemPrice never reaches originalPrice (re-read from the menu)
description: Server-authoritative money: BOGO_FREE sent with dealPrice 1 is stored at 10; PERCENT_OFF 10% sent with dealPrice 999 is stored at 9. A COMBO whose rows claim itemPrice 99 / 50 is snapshotted at the menu's 10 / 6.50 — originalPrice 16.50, not 149 — so the advertised savings can't be inflated.
